title: Virtual Casino
overview:
Set in 3D space! The Sega Saturn's first casino game has arrived!

Step onto the floor of a casino built from 3D polygons and try your luck at the tables against the house dealers. Place your bets at roulette, baccarat, blackjack and poker, or chase a bonus game on the slot machines, while CG movie scenes tell a dramatic story along the way.

- 1-2 players, with simultaneous two-player play

舞台は3D空間！
セガサターン初のカジノゲーム登場！
